comments.body:
You’ll be fine, you won’t be living it up but it’s totally doable. Even with the higher cost of living here 55k will go a lot further than the 15-30k you’d get in much of the rest of Europe. 

A cheap shared flat within 30 mins door to door of ETH should be findable well under 1000. Expect to pay more if you want to be really central. 

After food and expenses you’ll still have money to go out, explore Switzerland, and travel abroad.
